test_title: PYST 36: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CLOCK’ is written as ‘XHLAJ’ and ‘FAITH’ is written as ‘AWFRG’. How will ‘BEACH’ be written in that language?
solution:
The table showing the positional values of the alphabets is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91e0297a5db4aa5f28388add01b94144d4d79fc342d5b33c2c2473e2e8dc2a23.png] 

Here, the following logic is used.

** ‘CLOCK’ is written as ‘XHLAJ’**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3ac66a6a31d41b28eaee1b7062f1026536767f91617f975fd9677c141e0b2de.png] 

** ‘FAITH’ is written as ‘AWFRG’**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ddf53ee644198c7b2b5e1b0f19cf5a9a2b68884346f88d912149fb85e7293ce.png] 

**‘BEACH’ be written as '?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2365b3d86b9f62139633004fb328a2106733c27231a09c689dbb10fcecdb4921.png] 

Therefore,** '?' **will be replaced by** 'WAXAG'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **option(4)**
